correctness.rationale: Unique factorization reduces equality of two values to equality of all coordinate gcds. The identity \(\operatorname{lcm}_i\gcd(e_i,\alpha)=\gcd(\operatorname{lcm}_i e_i,\alpha)\) was reconstructed prime-adically, proving the converse direction. Divisors of \(L\) provide all and only the fibers; elementary coprime counting gives \(\varphi(L/d)\); and comparing the parameters \(L\) and \(L+T\) proves every period \(T\) is a multiple of \(L\). The deterministic verifier checks 780 exponent tuples and 479656 parameter pairs, but the infinite theorem rests on the symbolic proof.

value.rationale: The source literature treats periodicity and, later, the orbit of this parameterized arithmetic function. The theorem completes that natural parameter-dynamics question for every fixed integer: it identifies the exact quotient of the parameter set, proves the source period is minimal, gives the orbit cardinality in closed form, and supplies exact fiber frequencies. These are structural invariants of the orbit, not a finite numerical slice or a restatement of the source theorem.
